## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-ci`, `area:sparse_attention`, `op: DSA`.

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure

## Summary

The DSA hardware-validation cases skipped on every part but cc 10.0, although the code they cover serves cc 10.3:

- `dsa_utils._require_exact_sm100` (13 cases in `test_DSA_sparse_attention_backward.py`, 2 in `test_DSA_sparse_score_recompute.py`) required exactly `(10, 0)`. The sparse attention backward maps cc 10.3 to `sm_103a` (`_SM100_FAMILY_ARCH_FLAGS`, `_BLACKWELL_CAPABILITIES`, the q-cluster gate), and the SM100 score recompute serves `compute_capability >= 10`.
- `test_DSA_indexer_backward.py` kept its own `_require_exact_sm100` (22 cases), whose docstring said SM103 end-to-end execution was "intentionally not required by this suite yet". It also required SM100 on the second device of the two-device case. The public gate accepts both parts (`INDEXER_BACKWARD_SM100_CAPABILITIES = ((10, 0), (10, 3))`).

Both helpers become `_require_sm100_family`, which accepts `(10, 0)` and `(10, 3)`. The two-device case accepts either part on the second device. No product code changes.

## Why

These cases never ran on a B300; this PR runs them there.

## Related issues

None found.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Test only.

## Testing

B300 (cc 10.3), develop `64ed3dfe` with its own extension, torch 2.14.1+cu130, cuDNN 9.27.0, CuTe DSL 4.8.1, `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`, `python -m pytest -m "L0 or L1" deepseek_sparse_attention/cutedsl/<module>` from `test/python`:

| Module | develop | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| `test_DSA_sparse_attention_backward.py` | 306 passed, 62 skipped | 349 passed, 19 skipped (SM90 only) |
| `test_DSA_indexer_backward.py` | 52 passed, 59 skipped | 110 passed, 1 skipped (needs two GPUs) |
| `test_DSA_sparse_score_recompute.py` | 30 passed, 20 skipped | 50 passed |

The two-device indexer case still skips here: one GPU was visible.

Not run on cc 10.0, where the helpers admit the part as before.

The passing cases include deterministic backward, workspace contracts, streams and CUDA Graph replay. CI pipeline 78144731 matches all changed files.
